title: The Night the Sky Went Quiet
body:
The first lantern of the Starlight Festival is yours to light. Mira holds the match while your new Pokémon partner waits at your feet. “One flame for those at home,” she says, “and one for those finding their way.” You steady the lantern together, and your partner looks up as if to ask, Ready?

Then every star above the valley vanishes. The old mountain bell rings three times. Something silver drifts down into your palm: a seed, warm as a sunlit pebble, pulsing in time with a faint cry from the mountain. Mira grips the matchbox. “I know that bell.”

choices.label: Ask Mira what the bell means
choices.immediateText: “That is the tower’s emergency bell,” Mira says. “No one rings it for fun.”

choices.label: Show Mira the strange seed
choices.immediateText: Mira cups her hands around the seed. “An emergency key. I hoped I would never see another.”

choices.label: Hold your partner close and ask whether it is safe
choices.immediateText: Mira kneels beside you. “Stay together. I’ll keep my lantern where you can see it.”

variants.starter=Bulbasaur: Bulbasaur steadies the lantern with one careful vine. A spare festival ribbon is proudly wrapped around the other.
variants.starter=Charmander: Charmander shields a tiny flame with both paws, keeping its tail safely away from the paper decorations.
variants.starter=Squirtle: Squirtle catches the tipping matchbox before it falls into a puddle, then checks your lantern with the expression of a strict fire-safety inspector.

title: Mira and the Missing Piece
body:
Under the festival awning, Mira spreads out a map. Moonwood, the Lumen River, the mountain trail—and a neat hole where Starfall Tower should be. “I cut it out after someone got hurt up there,” she admits. “I thought keeping people away would keep them safe.” An Eevee shivers beneath her chair. You crouch nearby while Mira puts a map and a spare wool scarf into your pack.

“The Starlight Glass catches light for the tower’s lamps and heaters,” Mira says. “The stars are still there; their light isn’t reaching us. This seed is its call for help.” She draws the missing tower onto your map and fastens a pouch for the seed to your belt. “Follow its glow. I’ll send blankets and food up the supply trail, and keep a lantern here for signals. Come back if the path feels unsafe.”

choices.label: Ask who lives in the tower
choices.immediateText: “Lumi the Clefairy,” Mira says, “and often her friend Shinx. They have not visited today.”

choices.label: Ask why the Glass might need help
choices.immediateText: “It should release its stored light each morning,” Mira says. “Someone may be keeping the catch shut.”

choices.label: Comfort Eevee and invite it along
choices.immediateText: Eevee considers your outstretched hand, then jumps into your arms. Mira packs an extra berry for your new traveling friend.

choices.label: Ask Eevee to stay with Mira and watch the lanterns
choices.immediateText: Eevee climbs onto Mira’s table and begins the important job of inspecting lantern wicks.

title: Three Notes on the Hill
body: From the hill you can see the river winding toward the mountain. Hoothoot guards a nest beneath a leaning branch. It sings three notes—low, high, low—and the seed answers with three flashes. A matching owl is carved on Mira’s map beside the observatory. Hoothoot looks from the branch to your hands. Apparently, being tall comes with responsibilities.

choices.label: Lift the branch and make the nest safe
choices.immediateText: You lift the branch while your partner braces it with a forked stick. Hoothoot checks the nest, fluffs its feathers, and sings the three notes again.

choices.label: Mark the branch on Mira’s map so she can repair it
choices.immediateText: You sketch the branch on your map and flash its position to Mira. Her lantern answers twice. Helpers will come; Hoothoot stays beside the nest until they arrive.

choices.label: Secure the nest, then invite Hoothoot along
choices.immediateText: You and your partner brace the branch with a fallen fork of wood. Hoothoot checks the nest, sings its three notes again, and hops onto your pack. Your music teacher is coming along.

choices.label: Thank Hoothoot and leave quietly
choices.immediateText: Hoothoot bows, tips sideways, recovers with great dignity and stays to guard its nest.

variants.companion=Eevee: Eevee edges forward and offers Hoothoot a berry. The owl takes it with solemn ceremony.

title: Four Ways into Moonwood
body: Four paths leave the village gate. Roots arch over the way into the grove; a ridge rises to the right; a brook curls away to the left. Between them, the seed lights a narrow track beneath the trees. You brush mud from the signpost and compare it with Mira’s map. Somewhere in Moonwood, a twig snaps.

choices.label: Take the root arch
choices.immediateText: You duck beneath the root arch and follow the sheltered path into the grove.

responses.text: Bulbasaur holds the smallest roots aside until the last friend has passed, then lowers them gently.

choices.label: Climb the ridge
choices.immediateText: You take the marked climbing path and soon hear the wind crossing the rocky hillside.

choices.label: Follow the brook
choices.immediateText: You follow the stream and clear the mud from the old wooden sign before reading it.

choices.label: Trust the seed’s narrow trail
choices.immediateText: The seed brightens at every fork and brings you through the quiet understory to the grove.

variants.starter=Bulbasaur: Bulbasaur offers to ease the roots apart rather than tear them.
variants.starter=Charmander: Charmander checks the ridge for dry leaves before lighting the way.
variants.starter=Squirtle: Squirtle points out where the brook is shallow enough to cross.

title: A Feather in the Wind
body: A fallen branch narrows the ridge ahead. A loose owl feather trembles beneath it; below, you can just make out Hoothoot’s hill and the brook beyond. This branch has fallen from a different tree, right across the path. Your partner finds a foothold in the heather. High on the mountain, a pale flash sweeps across a tower window and disappears.

choices.label: Secure the fallen branch before leaving
choices.immediateText: You secure the branch above the narrow path. The loose feather drifts free, and the way is clear for the next traveler.

choices.label: Mark the dangerous spot on Mira’s map
choices.immediateText: You sketch the fallen branch and mark a safer detour for the next traveler.

choices.label: Follow the high trail straight into the grove
choices.immediateText: You take the high route down through the heather and enter the grove from above.

variants.nest=saved OR companion=Hoothoot: The forked support on the hill is still holding. You remember how relieved Hoothoot looked when the nest was safe.

title: The Letter in the Water
body: A bottle taps against a stone in the brook. Inside, cramped handwriting fills a scrap of paper: “I was trying to help. I cannot open it again. Please bring the dawn. —L.” Beside the letter is a smudged paw print. Above the bank, an old cable climbs toward the tower. A waterwheel turns beneath it, driving a little message basket uphill; a sign says TOWER POST.

choices.label: Keep the letter to show its writer
choices.immediateText: You fold the note carefully and place it in the dry pocket of your pack.

choices.label: Send a reply: “We are coming. You are not alone.”
choices.immediateText: You write your answer on the back of the letter, tuck it into the bottle, and place it in the message basket. The waterwheel carries it uphill until it is a speck against the rocks.

responses.text: Hoothoot watches the cable carefully and hoots when the basket clears a crooked pulley.

choices.label: Copy the paw print onto Mira’s map
choices.immediateText: You draw the paw-shaped mark, including its small uneven streak, on the map margin.

variants.know=lumi_name: You wonder whether the initial L means Lumi. You cannot know for sure yet.

title: Moonwood Holds Its Breath
body: Silver ivy creaks around an old lamp post. Between the stems, a Pikachu struggles to free one paw. When your lantern swings closer, the ivy curls tighter; you stop at once. Beyond the post, mushrooms glow along one path and an enormous tree spreads its roots across another. Pikachu gives a sharp squeak. It is trying very hard not to sound frightened.

choices.label: Stop and free Pikachu
choices.immediateText: You kneel so you can see the knot without pulling the trapped paw. “We’re here,” you tell Pikachu.

choices.label: Study the mushroom trail first
choices.immediateText: You hang a help flag at the lantern marker for Mira’s forest helpers, showing exactly where Pikachu is trapped. Then you follow the mushrooms.

choices.label: Ask the old tree whether there is a safe way through
choices.immediateText: You mark the lamp post on your map and hang a help flag at the trail marker for Mira’s forest helpers. Then you follow the roots toward the old tree.

variants.companion=Hoothoot: Hoothoot warns you that bright light makes the ivy curl tighter.

title: The Smallest Spark
body:
You shade the lantern with your coat. The ivy stops tightening, but the loop still grips Pikachu’s paw. “Hold still—just a moment,” you whisper. Pikachu plants its free foot against the post and waits.

Pikachu tumbles out, makes a fierce face at the ivy, then checks your fingers for scratches. A tiny spark brushes the seed, and its flickering glow settles. Pikachu points urgently toward the tower.

choices.label: Invite Pikachu to join the journey
choices.immediateText: Pikachu leaps onto the path at your side, then bumps your ankle as if to say thank you.

choices.label: Ask Pikachu to stay and keep the forest paths safe
choices.immediateText: Pikachu salutes with a small spark and races down the forest trail. You agree it will meet you near the observatory if it can.

choices.label: Share food and ask what Pikachu saw
choices.immediateText: Pikachu draws three bright circles in the soil and points toward the tower. You copy the shape onto your map.

variants.starter=Bulbasaur: Bulbasaur slides a vine beneath the ivy stem and lifts its weight. You ease the loose loop over Pikachu’s toes.
variants.starter=Charmander: Charmander keeps its tail behind a rock and holds the heavy stem still with both paws. In the dim lantern light, you work the loop loose.
variants.starter=Squirtle: Squirtle wets the soil around the ivy’s roots. You lift the softened clump just enough to loosen the stem, and Pikachu slips its paw free.

title: The Little Constellation
body: Nine mushrooms shine beside a flat stone. Some caps glow gold; others blink pale blue. Beneath them, a carving reads: LITTLE LIGHTS CAN SHOW A GROWING WAY. The seed warms against your palm, but the stone stays shut. A chuckle comes from a hollow tree farther down the trail.

choices.label: Open the cache with the constellation you solved
choices.immediateText: The stone slides aside. You lift out a moon-rune, cool and smooth, with the tower’s crescent carved into its face.

choices.label: Follow the brightest mushrooms instead
choices.immediateText: The bright caps lead into a hollow tree. Someone inside giggles at your surprised expression.

choices.label: Trace the pattern on Mira’s map and take the root path
choices.immediateText: You trace the diagonal without opening the rune cache. Your copy may still help you recognize the tower symbol.

choices.label: Follow the lantern trail into the clearing
choices.immediateText: You follow the sheltered lantern track toward a circle of trees.

title: The Tree That Laughed
body: “Boo!” says the tree. “Oh. Too much?” A Gastly floats upside down between shelves of lost gloves, buttons, and travel journals. “People used to stop and tell me things,” it says, righting itself. “Now they hurry past. I may have moved a sign.” It offers to show you its best discovery in exchange for a story. “Preferably one with an embarrassing bit.”

choices.label: Tell Gastly something funny your partner did
choices.immediateText: Gastly laughs so hard it turns upside down twice. “You must visit more often. Come and see the archive!”

choices.label: Ask Gastly to stop confusing frightened travelers
choices.immediateText: Gastly droops for a moment, then replaces a false sign with a real one. “Only cheerful surprises from now on,” it promises.

choices.label: Share why the missing stars matter
choices.immediateText: Gastly listens without interrupting. “You had better see the real records,” it says at last.

title: The Echo Archive
body: Gastly floats ahead into a dry reading room. An astronomer’s notebook, dated a hundred years ago, shows the Glass feeding lamps and heaters during mountain storms. Three rings return its stored light safely. Beside it lies a much newer sheet: Lumi’s careful copies, with questions in the margins. “How long can it warm an injured friend?” she has written. The answer is underlined: UNTIL OTHER WARMTH IS READY. Gastly finds paper for one page of notes.

choices.label: Copy the safe opening instructions
choices.immediateText: You copy: “Establish a new source of warmth; release the catch; open the return path.”

choices.label: Copy the secret service stair map
choices.immediateText: You draw the staircase running beneath the observatory to the tower’s lower door.

choices.label: Copy the ring diagram and its costs
choices.immediateText: You copy three circles: SKY needs safe transport and warmth, HEART needs willing lantern keepers, EARTH needs a warm plant and gardeners.

title: The Oldest Tree
body: Roots as thick as benches cross the trail. Above them, a face opens in the bark of an ancient maple. “What grows brighter when shared?” it asks. Winged seeds rustle overhead. The tree glances at your silver seed. “Not one of mine. That came from a machine which remembered how to ask for help.” Behind the roots you glimpse a clearing, but the tree waits for your answer.

choices.label: Answer, “A light passed from one friend to another”
choices.immediateText: “Yes,” murmurs the tree. “One flame can light another.” Its roots lift, opening a doorway into the clearing.

choices.label: Answer, “A good idea”
choices.immediateText: The tree chuckles. “Especially when someone asks a better question!” Its roots lift to let you pass.

choices.label: Let Bulbasaur communicate with the roots
choices.immediateText: Bulbasaur rests a vine on the bark. The roots part and the tree offers a warm, wordless welcome.

choices.label: Ask the tree for a plain seed as a thank-you gift
choices.immediateText: A winged seed spins into your palm. “Plant it somewhere kind,” says the maple, raising its roots to show the clearing.

title: The Crescent Lens
body: In the clearing, moss cushions a stone pedestal. A crescent lens rests on top. When you hold the seed behind it, a picture trembles across the bark: someone climbing toward the tower, supporting a small, limping Pokémon. A yellow scarf catches the light. Before you can see their faces, the picture fades. You pack the lens carefully. Beside the pedestal hang a coil of rope and a small plaque: RETURN THE LIGHT WHEN OTHER WARMTH IS READY.

choices.label: Take the rope for difficult crossings
choices.immediateText: You roll the rope and clip it to your pack, ready for a slippery crossing.

choices.label: Use the moon-rune to copy the tower’s hidden door mark
choices.immediateText: The rune fits. A bright symbol appears on the lens; you record the lower-door mark.

choices.label: Plant the ordinary seed near the pedestal
choices.immediateText: You press the little brown seed into damp soil and water it with your drinking flask.

choices.label: Leave a lantern flame for the forest
choices.immediateText: You light a sheltered wick by the pedestal. It will help other travelers find the clearing.

variants.letter=kept: You unfold the letter. Its smudged paw print is just the right size for the smaller traveler.
variants.companion=Eevee: Eevee nudges your hand toward the place where the smaller figure leaned against its friend.
variants.pikachu=left: Two lantern flashes answer from the lamp post. Mira’s helpers have loosened the ivy, and Pikachu is safe with them. A small yellow spark follows their signal.

title: The River Without Reflections
body: The Lumen River usually carries a thousand trembling stars. Tonight, only your lantern ripples on the water. Lapras waits in a shallow pool, cut off by a fallen branch. Along the near bank stand a ferry landing and a reed workshop; upstream, a waterfall thunders. Beyond the falls, a little island divides the river. A trail climbs from its northern shore toward the mountain.

choices.label: Free Lapras from the shallow pool
choices.immediateText: Together you open the blocked channel. Lapras glides into deeper water and sings in relief.

choices.label: Repair the ferry to reach the island
choices.immediateText: You bring sound boards to the landing, where Psyduck is checking the ferry deck.

choices.label: Follow the waterfall trail
choices.immediateText: You follow a safe riverside ledge toward the noise of the bells.

choices.label: Search for the cave entrance marked on Mira’s map
choices.immediateText: The tower symbols in your notes match a mark above the stream. Following it, you find a dry side path into the cave.

title: The River Keeper
body: Water swirls through the channel you cleared. Lapras glides around the pool once, stretching its fins, then lowers its head to listen. When you point to the tower, it makes two shapes in the sand: a round-eared traveler and a smaller one leaning on her. They crossed here together. Lapras offers its broad back for the crossing, but keeps glancing downstream, where other travelers may need a guide.

choices.label: Ask Lapras to carry you to the island
choices.immediateText: Lapras lowers its neck so you can climb aboard, then carries you to the island’s pebble shore.

choices.label: Ask Lapras to guide other lost travelers
choices.immediateText: Lapras agrees to remain at the river. Its song follows you as you walk toward the ferry.

choices.label: Promise to help both travelers as well as bring back the light
choices.immediateText: Lapras answers with a steady song. “Both,” you repeat as it brings you across.

title: Psyduck and the Wobbly Ferry
body: Psyduck has lined up the ferry’s repaired boards from shortest to longest. It taps each one, listening for cracks. You hold them steady while Psyduck fastens them; together you test the empty ferry before stepping aboard. The deck holds. At the roar of the falls, Psyduck grips its head, then carefully checks the landing rope again. Its workshop door stands open behind you, full of reeds and little lanterns.

choices.label: Cross together slowly, giving Psyduck time
choices.immediateText: Psyduck places a foot on the deck, shivers, then completes the crossing with you. It decides to help manage the landing.

choices.label: Visit the reed workshop for safer equipment
choices.immediateText: Psyduck beckons you through the open workshop door and lifts a lantern from its shelf.

choices.label: Ask Psyduck to remain ferry keeper
choices.immediateText: Psyduck shows you how to pull the ferry along its guide rope, then stays at the landing to help the next travelers. You cross slowly and step onto the island.

variants.item=rope: Your rope makes a sound handrail across the ferry deck.

title: One Step at a Time
body: Psyduck’s workshop smells of wet wood. Finished lanterns bob in a testing basin; bent reeds fill a basket labeled TRY AGAIN. On the wall hang a drainage map and a row of tiny bells. Psyduck catches you looking at the basket and shrugs. Then it picks out one straight reed and gets to work. There is time for one project before you take the repaired ferry to the island.

choices.label: Build lanterns that can guide travelers after dark
choices.immediateText: Together you set out a chain of floating lanterns and mark their positions on the river map.

responses.text: Psyduck checks the ferry rope once more and guides you across to the island.

choices.label: Learn Psyduck’s slow breathing-and-bell rhythm
choices.immediateText: Psyduck teaches you a steady low–high–low pattern with a pause to breathe after each set.

responses.text: Psyduck checks the ferry rope once more and guides you across to the island.

choices.label: Copy the drainage tunnel route to the mountain
choices.immediateText: You draw the tunnel opening beneath the bridge and the service steps at its far end.

responses.text: Psyduck checks the ferry rope once more and guides you across to the island.

choices.label: Build lantern markers and invite Psyduck along
choices.immediateText: You finish the floating markers together. Psyduck hangs up a sign for the next ferry keeper, packs a little lantern, and chooses to come with you.

responses.text: Psyduck checks the ferry rope once more and guides you across to the island.

title: The Bell Behind the Water
body: Spray cools your cheeks beside the waterfall. Three bells hang outside a stone door, and their echoes weave through the roar of the water. A worn inscription says THE RIVER REMEMBERS. Through the crescent lens you see steps behind the door. To your right, a marked footpath curls around the falls toward the island.

choices.label: Open the door with the melody you discovered
choices.immediateText: The bells ring together. Water slides aside, revealing dry steps into the cave.

choices.label: Take the safe path around the falls
choices.immediateText: You leave the bells untouched and take the marked path along the bank to the island.

choices.label: Trace the waterfall’s rhythm for use later
choices.immediateText: You listen until the echo becomes clear, then tap low, high, low on your pack. Keeping the beat, you follow the footpath onto the island.

title: The Astronomer’s Quiet Cave
body: A wall drawing glimmers in your lantern light: three rings around a glass sphere. Beside the sky ring, someone has drawn a wrapped traveler; beside the heart ring, a circle of lanterns; beside the earth ring, a silver-leaved plant. Underneath, worn letters read: PREPARE THE WARMTH, THEN RELEASE THE LIGHT. A second drawing marks mountain paths. At the far end, moonlit mist shows the way out toward the island.

choices.label: Copy the rule for returning light before touching the rings
choices.immediateText: You write the old warning beside the ring diagram on Mira’s map.

choices.label: Sketch the three safe ways up the mountain
choices.immediateText: You draw the bridge, shelter detour and old service steps in separate lines.

choices.label: Look through the lens at the wall’s worn marks
choices.immediateText: Through the lens, faded lines become clear: each ring leads to the same release latch. You copy the drawing and follow the cave’s far passage to the island.

variants.arrival=falls: You climb the dry steps behind the waterfall and enter the cave.
variants.NOT arrival=falls: You follow the dry side path from the riverbank into the cave.

passages.text: You climb the dry steps behind the waterfall and enter the cave.
You follow the dry side path from the riverbank into the cave.

title: A Memory on the Island
body: On the island, stardust clings to a flat stone. Your lens catches it, and a memory flickers into view: a Clefairy helping a limping Shinx toward the mountain. Each wears a yellow scarf. “Lumi, slow down,” Shinx asks. Lumi stops, takes off her own scarf, and wraps it over his shoulders. The picture fades. He could speak and walk a little then—but you still do not know how he is now. The seed glows toward the high bridge.

choices.label: Say aloud what the memory tells you
choices.immediateText: “Lumi was trying to help Shinx,” you say. “But something else must have happened at the tower.”

choices.label: Promise to hear Lumi’s story before judging her
choices.immediateText: Your partner hears your promise and gives a small, serious nod.

choices.label: Use the lens to check whether Shinx could walk
choices.immediateText: You look again. Shinx took a few steps with Lumi’s help at the time of the memory. You mark that clue on your map and follow the mountain path.

choices.label: Keep the memory private until you can ask them
choices.immediateText: You fold your map shut. Their story should be theirs to tell first.

variants.know=lumi_name: You recognize Lumi’s name from Mira’s story. Now you have seen her for yourself.

title: The Bridge in the Wind
body: The island path climbs for nearly an hour before reaching a rope bridge. Across the gorge, the observatory clings to Starfall Tower’s lower wall; the tower room glows above it. The bridge boards are sound, but the wind makes them sway. Another path winds toward Altaria’s lookout. Far below the bridge, a narrow drainage tunnel cuts through the rock.

choices.label: Steady the rope bridge and cross together
choices.immediateText: You wait for the wind to ease and cross one at a time, holding the rail.

choices.label: Take the long path toward Altaria’s lookout
choices.immediateText: You turn uphill and follow the windbreak stones toward the lookout.

choices.label: Use Bulbasaur’s vines to anchor the bridge
choices.immediateText: Bulbasaur loops its vines around the sturdy posts on your side and braces the handrail. You cross one at a time, then Bulbasaur releases the vines and follows.

choices.label: Use the old drainage route beneath the bridge
choices.immediateText: You follow the marked tunnel beneath the exposed span and emerge by the old steps.

variants.knowledge=route: The three paths match your cave sketch. You turn the map so the gorge lies in the right direction.
variants.item=spareScarf: You wrap Mira’s thick spare scarf around your neck before stepping into the wind.

title: Altaria and the Lost Flock
body: Swablu cries drift through the mist. Altaria circles low, counting the chicks as they settle behind windbreak stones. One last squeak comes from a stone lantern beside the shelter path. Altaria lands near you and looks from the mist to the lantern. Her broad wings could carry you above the gorge, but she will not leave a chick behind.

choices.label: Help Altaria gather the little flock
choices.immediateText: You guide the last chick around the stone lantern. Altaria counts every head and leads the flock into its sheltered roost. With the chicks safe, she carries you to the observatory roof.

choices.label: Show Altaria where the missing chick is hiding
choices.immediateText: Altaria gathers the chick beneath a wing and guides you toward her shelter.

choices.label: Take the marked walking trail
choices.immediateText: You take the marked path. Behind you, the hidden chick gives an enormous sneeze. Altaria hears it, gathers the last straggler, and brings the flock toward the shelter.

title: Cloudberry Shelter
body: All the Swablu are tucked into the sheltered roost when you round the bend. Altaria checks them once more, then nudges a cracked food bowl with her beak. Berries have rolled into the grass. A warm loose feather rests beside the nest. Above the berry bushes, one path climbs to the observatory; another follows the tower’s sheltered service steps.

choices.label: Repair the bowl and ask for a feather
choices.immediateText: You mend the bowl with cord. Altaria places one warm feather in your hands.

choices.label: Share food and request a warm feather
choices.immediateText: Altaria accepts the shared meal and gives you a soft feather for a cold night.

choices.label: Continue to the observatory without taking anything
choices.immediateText: You thank Altaria and follow the clear path up to the observatory.

choices.label: Take the marked service steps toward the tower
choices.immediateText: You follow the winding service steps to the lower tower approach.

variants.altaria=found: The chick you spotted settles beside your boot. Altaria brushes your shoulder with a wing.

title: The Steps with Two Scarves
body: Stone stairs curve around the observatory wall. A yellow scarf is caught beneath a railing: SHINX, say the crooked stitches. You lift it free, fold it, and put it safely in your pack. In a weatherproof box nearby, a photograph shows Lumi and Shinx wearing matching scarves, each with its owner’s name. A crescent marks the service door. The ordinary steps continue upward beside it.

choices.label: Keep Shinx’s scarf safe and follow the outer steps
choices.immediateText: You check that the scarf is secure in your pack and climb toward the observatory.

choices.label: Use the marked service passage to reach the tower door
choices.immediateText: Your copied clues lead you beneath the platform and up the service passage to the tower door.

choices.label: Take the outside route up to the observatory roof
choices.immediateText: You tuck the scarf safely away and climb the protected outside steps.

title: The Observatory That Forgot the Sky
body: Frost grips the observatory’s platform controls. Through the windows you can see the covered walkway to the tower room, but its roof latch will not turn. Three little mechanisms connect to it: plant-shaped sockets, frozen gears, and water basins. Your partner examines the worn instruction pictures. A hand crank and an outside stair offer other ways to reach the latch.

choices.label: Solve the observatory mechanism with your partner
choices.immediateText: The mechanism clicks into place. Your partner tests the latch twice, looking very pleased, and the platform opens toward the roof.

choices.label: Use the hand crank and work together
choices.immediateText: You take turns at the stiff crank. At last the latch lifts, and a little shower of frost falls from the roof.

choices.label: Climb the safe outside staircase
choices.immediateText: The staircase leads to a manual release. You lift it and open the roof.

variants.pikachu=guard: A familiar spark flashes on the path below. Pikachu has finished guiding the forest travelers and comes to brace the crank. After helping, it will return to its post.

title: Across the Last Gap
body: From the observatory roof you hear footsteps in the tower room. A covered walkway crosses the gap below; above it, broad glowing stones form a short crossing between sturdy rails. Your lens shows their stone supports beneath the shimmer. A sheltered stair curls around the rock to the same landing. Beside the walkway hangs a bell cord with a moon-shaped handle.

choices.label: Cross the covered walkway to the door
choices.immediateText: The covered walkway shelters you from the wind as you cross to the tower.

choices.label: Cross the stepping-stones carefully
choices.immediateText: You test each glowing stone before placing your weight on it and reach the door safely.

choices.label: Ring the gentle moon-bell before approaching
choices.immediateText: The bell answers with three soft notes. You hear footsteps move toward the door.

choices.label: Take the sheltered stair around the gorge
choices.immediateText: The old stone stair curves beneath the platform and arrives at the tower’s lower landing.

title: Someone Behind the Door
body: “One, two, three. Please, one more night.” A muffled voice counts behind the closed door. Another voice answers, tired but quite clear: “Lumi, I’m not sleeping.” You breathe out. Shinx is here, and he can speak. Through a narrow window beside the door, you see a yellow scarf on a chair. LUMI is stitched along its edge; she has her own scarf back. The seed warms in your hand.

choices.label: Knock and introduce yourself
choices.immediateText: You give your name and your partner’s name without demanding that Lumi open at once.

choices.label: Call gently that you came because the silver seed asked for help
choices.immediateText: You show the warm silver seed through the narrow window and explain that it led you here.

choices.label: Hold up Shinx’s lost scarf and ask to return it
choices.immediateText: You unfold the scarf, keeping it dry and clean, so the Pokémon inside can see the name.

choices.label: Ask whether Shinx is all right before anything else
choices.immediateText: You ask about Shinx instead of the machine. Someone inside moves closer.

variants.item=shinxScarf: Shinx’s matching scarf is still dry in your pack. You can offer it through the window.
variants.arrival=service: The sheltered service passage has brought your whole party to this landing, out of the wind.
variants.arrival=bell: The counting stops. Your three soft bell notes have been heard.
variants.knowledge=door OR knowledge=stair: The mark beside the door matches the one you copied. Your notes have brought you right to the landing.

title: The Keeper Who Was Afraid
body:
Lumi opens the door a hand’s width. The little Clefairy has tired eyes, but her grip on the handle is firm. Behind her, Shinx lies beside a glass sphere full of spinning light. One paw is bandaged. “Keep the door out of the wind,” Lumi says, and makes room for you. Shinx lifts his head. “Visitors. Excellent. Perhaps someone will talk to me.”

Lumi keeps one hand near the controls. “The Glass kept him warm after the fall. I don’t know how to let it stop.” Nobody reaches for a lever.

choices.label: Ask Lumi exactly what happened after the accident
choices.immediateText: “I need to know where the danger began,” you say. Lumi takes a shaky breath and starts at the storm.

choices.label: Show Lumi the letter you kept
choices.immediateText: Lumi takes the letter and smooths its damp corner. “I wrote this before I stopped answering the door.”

choices.label: Tell her you came to listen, not to blame
choices.immediateText: You sit where Lumi can see you clearly and wait for her to speak.

choices.label: Return Shinx’s scarf and let him speak
choices.immediateText: Shinx takes back the scarf and wraps it around his neck before clearing his throat.

variants.reply=sent: Your bottle stands beside the post basket. Lumi unfolds your reply. “You said you were coming.” She reads the last line again: You are not alone.
variants.contact=knock: “Thank you for knocking,” Lumi says. “I kept expecting someone to bang on the door.”
variants.contact=seed: Lumi recognizes the seed. “It sent for help even when I couldn’t.” She loosens her grip on the handle.
variants.contact=shinx: “My paw hurts,” Shinx tells you. “And I’d like to stop being a secret.” Lumi looks down at her feet.
variants.contact=scarf: Shinx’s ears rise when he sees his scarf. “I knew the mountain hadn’t eaten it.”
variants.letter=kept: You recognize the smudged paw print on the letter: Shinx has the same little streak of ink on his good paw.
variants.promise=listen: You remember your promise on the island and sit down before asking anything. Lumi pulls a stool closer.
variants.privacy=yes: You leave the memory on the island unmentioned. “Would you like to tell us?” you ask instead.

title: The Truth Between Two Friends
body:
“The bell rope broke in the storm,” Lumi says. “Shinx slipped while we were fixing it.” His paw was hurt, his sparks flickered, and the wind made him terribly cold. Lumi knew how to use the Glass’s heater. She did not know how long help would take. “I kept turning it up. Then I held the keeper’s catch shut.” She shows you the little handle beneath her thumb. “It won’t release the light until I let someone else take over the warmth.”

“I want to get better,” Shinx says. “I also want you to sleep. And I want the sky back.” You tell them Mira has sent supplies. Through the window, a lantern flashes from the service trail below: the helpers have reached the supply porch. Lumi finally lifts her thumb from the catch. Just a little.

choices.label: Ask Shinx what kind of help he wants first
choices.immediateText: You give Shinx time to answer. “Warmth, a rest, and a chance to decide what happens next,” he says.

choices.label: Promise Lumi that she need not carry the work alone
choices.immediateText: Lumi lets her shoulders drop. “I will ask next time,” she says, “even if I am embarrassed.”

choices.label: Share the old rules you discovered
choices.immediateText: You show Lumi the rule you copied, and she points out the safe release latch.

choices.label: Ask Lumi to show you how the three rings work
choices.immediateText: Lumi demonstrates each ring with one small spark rather than risking the whole sphere.

variants.talk=history: “I thought Mira would blame him,” Lumi admits. Shinx snorts. “For falling? I wasn’t doing it on purpose.”
variants.talk=letter: Lumi folds the returned letter. “I could ask on paper. At the door, I kept losing the words.”
variants.talk=scarf: Shinx tucks his own scarf under his chin. “Two scarves was too warm once we got inside. I gave Lumi’s back. Then we noticed mine was missing.”
variants.companion=Eevee: Eevee sits beside Lumi’s stool. After a moment, Lumi rests a hand on its head.
variants.clue=pawprint: The ink on Shinx’s paw matches the print you drew on your map. He sees you looking. “I helped with the letter. Holding the bottle was my job.”
variants.clue=flash: You show Lumi the three circles Pikachu drew. “It saw the rings through the window,” she says. “I wish I had opened the door then.”

title: Three Rings, One Sky
body:
You and Lumi bring the helpers’ parcel in from the supply porch: blankets, food, a padded carrier, and covered lanterns. She checks each item before laying it beside Shinx. “Mira hid a piece of the map to keep people safe,” you tell her. Lumi looks at the locked sphere. “And I shut a door.” She turns to the three rings.

The SKY ring can open once Shinx has a warm carrier and a safe way down. The HEART ring can send warmth into lanterns held by willing helpers. The EARTH ring can grow the silver seed into a plant that stores warmth. Lumi touches the release catch beneath them. “Whichever we choose, the warmth must be ready first.”

Mira’s lantern answers from the village: a warm room is waiting. “Please ask before picking me up,” Shinx says. Lumi sets the carrier down again and waits for his nod.

choices.label: Prepare a safe immediate release with the sky ring
choices.immediateText: You check the blanket, the door and the way down before touching the sky ring.

choices.label: Ask willing friends to form a shared warmth circle
choices.immediateText: You ask everyone in turn, including Shinx, whether they want to help.

choices.label: Carry the seed to the garden balcony for the earth ring
choices.immediateText: You and Lumi carry the seed into the growing light beside the balcony planter.

choices.label: Ask Mira to organize help from Willowbrook before release
choices.immediateText: You flash Mira’s festival signal from the tower window. A bright reply rises from the village.

variants.shinxChoice=asked: Shinx points to the carrier. “That looks comfortable. But let me decide when we move.” You put it within his reach.
variants.lumiTrust=promise: Lumi hands you one of the lanterns. “Then this can be your job.” Her hand no longer shakes quite so much.
variants.knowledge=shared: Your copied rule lies beside the controls. Lumi checks the diagram against the catch, then nods. “Now we both know.”
variants.knowledge=demonstrated: Lumi sends one tiny spark around the demonstration dial and brings it back. Shinx watches every turn.
variants.choice=lapras.3: You tell Shinx about the promise you made beside Lapras: you came for both friends, as well as the light. “Good,” he says. “She needs looking after too.”
variants.companion=Psyduck: Psyduck lines up the supplies in order of use, just as it lined up the ferry boards. Shinx approves the blanket pile.
variants.companion=Pikachu: Pikachu offers a tiny spark for a lantern, then waits. Shinx nods. Lumi watches them agree before either moves.
variants.companion=Hoothoot: Hoothoot taps three times on your pack. Shinx taps back, a little too quickly, and the owl gives him a very serious look.

title: The Sky Ring
body: Lumi warms a smooth stone with the Glass’s heater, wraps it, and checks it against her wrist. You line the carrier with a blanket. Shinx tries it, wriggles, and asks you to move a lumpy corner. Outside, the helpers wait by the sheltered path down to Mira’s warm room. The release catch stays shut while you make the last preparations.

choices.label: Settle Shinx in the warm carrier, then release the light
choices.immediateText: Shinx nods. You lift the carrier with a helper, and Lumi checks that the wrapped stone is still warm. She takes her place at the release catch.

choices.label: Use Altaria’s feather to make a warm nest, then open the Glass
choices.immediateText: Altaria’s feather unfolds into a soft lining around the wrapped warm stone. Shinx settles into the nest and approves it with a sleepy blink.

choices.label: Ask Charmander to maintain safe warmth during the release
choices.immediateText: Charmander takes a steady place beside the carrier, its tail safely clear of the bedding. Shinx tests the warmth with his good paw and nods.

choices.label: Use the steady bell rhythm to help Shinx rest while releasing the light
choices.immediateText: You settle Shinx beside the wrapped warm stone. He taps his good paw: ready for the three notes, and for Lumi to open the catch.

variants.item=feather: You lay Altaria’s warm feather beside the carrier. It is wide enough to line the nest.
variants.starter=Charmander: Charmander measures a safe space beside the carrier with its paws, then looks to Shinx for permission.

title: The Heart Ring
body: Lumi sets three covered lanterns around Shinx’s bed. You and your partner each agree to watch one; she takes the third. A thread of gold runs from the heart ring into their glass panes. “Warm enough?” she asks. Shinx holds out his good paw. “A little closer, please.” Far below, Mira signals that the village volunteers are ready too. Lumi leaves the release catch shut until you decide who will take the next watch.

choices.label: Link the ring to Mira’s festival lanterns and share the work with the village
choices.immediateText: The village lanterns answer your signal, each giving a tiny part of its light without going dark.

choices.label: Keep a staffed recovery room at the tower while the light returns
choices.immediateText: Lumi writes the names of willing helpers on the observatory slate. Shinx approves the timetable.

choices.label: Use a familiar three-note melody to guide the shared release
choices.immediateText: You begin the familiar melody. Shinx counts with his paw while the lantern keepers check that their little circle is warm.

choices.label: Let Shinx set the pace as the warmth passes between helpers
choices.immediateText: “Wait,” says Shinx, then checks each lantern. At last he nods. Lumi waits beside the catch for his own count of three.

variants.plan=village: Mira’s reply names the first village shift. The helpers on the supply porch unpack extra lanterns for the walk down.

title: A Seed for Tomorrow
body:
On the sheltered garden balcony, Lumi sets a pot of soil beneath the earth ring. You lower the silver seed into it. A root uncurls, then a star-shaped leaf, soft as a new fern. The leaf glows warm against your palm. “Its other job,” Lumi whispers. “An emergency key that can grow a new source of warmth.” You put the pot beside Shinx’s carrier. He leans toward it. “That one can sit by me.”

title: The Homeward Dawn
entry: sky, heart or earth as specified
body:
Lumi opens the catch. Starlight pours across the valley, and the river shines again. Shinx stays warm beside the wrapped stone as you and a helper carry him down; Lumi walks alongside with your lantern. At the village gate, Mira waits with warm water, clean bandages, and a bed by the fire. Shinx asks to walk the last three steps. He manages two, then accepts a hand for the third.

When everyone has rested, you plant the quiet silver seed in Mira’s window box. Lumi helps Mira draw a proper tower map, with the safe paths clearly marked. At the next festival, you and your partner light the first lantern together. Across the square, two yellow scarves wave back.

title: The Aurora Promise
entry: sky, heart or earth as specified
body:
The nest stays warm as Lumi opens the sky ring. Light spills out across the mountain in green and gold curtains. Behind them, the real stars have been waiting all along. Shinx sinks into his blanket. “Worth staying awake for,” he says, and promptly falls asleep. With the carrier ready, you follow the helpers down to Mira’s warm room.

Shinx heals slowly. His first hop earns a cheer; his second earns a firm “Enough for today” from Mira. The silver seed grows quietly in a pot outside her recovery room. One evening, Lumi comes to watch the stars with you and forgets to count them.

title: The River of Stars
entry: sky, heart or earth as specified
body:
Low, high, low. The tune from the hill fills the tower. Shinx taps the last beat with his good paw, and Lumi opens the catch. Light glitters down the mountain and gathers in the river’s ripples. You keep singing until Lumi’s tight shoulders finally settle.

After Shinx has rested, you plant the silver seed beside the river path. By the next festival it has a few shining leaves. The village sings your three notes before lighting the lanterns, with Shinx proudly leading. He is spectacularly out of tune. Nobody minds.

title: The Starlight Sanctuary
entry: sky, heart or earth as specified
body:
Shinx chooses the window bed. From there he can see the stars without moving his sore paw. Lumi brings the volunteers’ slate, and he studies the names before adding hers to the list marked REST. “Doctor’s orders!” he announces. She laughs, then pulls up a chair.

With Mira’s help, the observatory becomes a place for tired travelers to rest. Shinx’s paw takes time to heal, but visitors always get a welcome. Above the door, Lumi hangs a new sign: PLEASE KNOCK. WE ARE HERE.

title: The Lantern League
entry: sky, heart or earth as specified
body:
One by one, the village lanterns answer Mira’s signal. A chain of gold climbs the mountain path. Their keepers share the warmth, and Lumi opens the catch: starlight washes over rooftops, river, and forest. You carry Shinx down among the lanterns to Mira’s hearth. He keeps his good paw on Lumi’s hand.

The silver seed takes root beside the festival lantern stand. At the next celebration, Lumi speaks beneath its little leaves. “I thought I had to do everything myself.” Shinx clears his throat. “Exhausting to watch.” Even Lumi laughs. You help your partner light the first lantern. This time, a hundred flames answer.

title: The Living Constellation
entry: sky, heart or earth as specified
body:
The silver leaf glows steadily beside Shinx. Lumi checks the warmth one last time, then releases the catch. Starlight reaches the valley again. You carry Shinx and the padded pot down together, with a helper steadying the carrier and Lumi lighting the path.

Lumi keeps a garden journal. Shinx adds small, crooked drawings in the margins. At dusk, you sit beside the warm leaves and look up. The little tree has its own light. The sky has all its stars.
